text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today was the shopping district's festival.
In front of a certain food stall, I spotted
Jungle Pocket, Agnes Tachyon, and Manhattan Cafe.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, why on earth must I run a takoyaki stall...
Pokke-kun could have easily handled this alone.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Come on, this shop belongs to an upperclassman who helped me out!
Once we get going, it'll be a blast! Trust me!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Regardless... our shift has already begun...
Let us just do what needs to be done.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
That's our Cafe~! All right!
The three of us are gonna snag first place in sales!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
—A is for Azobenzene, A-A-A~♪
I is for Imidazole, I-I-I~♪

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Heh, what's with you?! You're in an awfully good mood!
Told ya it'd be fun once you tried it, right?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Humph. I simply shifted my perspective.
I decided to view this as a splendid experiment.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? Experiment?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
People often speak of a 'lingering taste' or an 'addictive flavor.'
In essence, it is nothing less than detonating an explosive
upon the gustatory and trigeminal nerves.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Thus, I am searching for a seasoning balance pushed to the absolute
limit of what the brain can tolerate. This will also serve my research—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...Cut that out!
Don't go turning the customers into guinea pigs!!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Ah... we have a customer... party of one...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Ooh! Welcome!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? There ain't nobody here?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...They are there. Right there...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
—No way, that's creepy as hell!? Please leave!!
Besides, ghosts don't even need to eat, right?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. Then let us appeal to the living instead.
I shall synthesize a chemical compound that emits an aroma
stimulating primal instincts—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I told you, knock that off!
Just use normal salt or something—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me... salt would... purify them, so...
or so the customer says...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Gaaah!? You're STILL here?!
Tell 'em to go home already!!
We're barely keeping this stall running as it is!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Argh, seriously! Let's go over the steps one more time!
Get it straight in your heads who's doing what!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Though they verbally confirmed their roles time and again,
each had a completely different agenda, leaving their
teamwork in utter shambles—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...It is finally over, then...
Though I would hardly call it... a success...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
My, how fascinating. A result far exceeding expectations.
To think our coordination could be so thoroughly discordant.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
—Pfft.
BWAHAHAHAHA!!!!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...What is... so amusing...?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Man, that was a total disaster, but
somehow it ended up being a blast!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Doing stuff with you guys is always hilarious!
Let's definitely do it again! Deal?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, indeed. I have various hypotheses to test regarding
just how much one can manipulate a subject's brain
through elements such as aroma and taste.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Nah, forget that nerd stuff! We gotta give the stall
a badass paint job, customize the frame—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Both of you are... equally ridiculous.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Their conversation was all over the place,
and yet, the trio clearly shared an undeniable bond.

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Voice
text_block_list.text: Hell yeah! Let's do it!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, look at you getting into it!
Next time, we're taking the top spot for sure!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ? I didn't say a word.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Neither... did I.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...Eeeek!?
Just how long do you plan on sticking around, ghost customer?!
